newsitem.title: USA: Most in U.S. want McVeigh executed if convicted - poll.
newsitem.headline: Most in U.S. want McVeigh executed if convicted - poll.

text.p: Seven out of ten adults polled by Newsweek say accused Oklahoma City bomber Timothy McVeigh should be executed if found guilty, the magazine reported on Saturday.

The 71 percent who favoured execution in the Oklahoma City case compared with 66 percent who supported it in general, Newsweek said. McVeigh is on trial in Denver in connection with an explosion at the Alfred P. Murrah federal building that killed 168 people.

Of the 502 Americans polled by telephone on Friday, 66 percent said they thought McVeigh should be found guilty. If he is not, 43 percent said they expected others would attempt violence similar to the 1995 bombing.
The poll, by Princeton Research Associates, had a margin of error of plus or minus five percentage points.
